components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with SJC Crimson background and subtle hover press feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7B1E22; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5C1016; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Light Glass Card Container
components.description: Translucent iOS light glass panel card for dashboard metrics and data tables.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; color: #0F172A; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04); } .ds-card-val { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #7B1E22; margin-top: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The NovaLunch design system delivers an airy, highly legible, iOS-inspired light glassmorphism interface tailored for Saint Joseph College (SJC). Designed for multi-role efficiency, it combines crisp translucent white surfaces, soft ambient elevation shadows, and SJC Crimson branding.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent light frosted glass panels with backdrop blur.
Institutional SJC Crimson paired with vibrant Amber Gold accents.
Pill-shaped interaction controls and continuous curvature container cards.

rules.name: The 10% Crimson Accent Rule
rules.body: Crimson accent is reserved for primary actions, current active tabs, and key badges.

rules.name: The Light Frosted Glass Rule
rules.body: Elevation is created using translucent white backgrounds, backdrop blurs (12px to 20px), hairline borders, and soft ambient drop shadows.

dos: Do use translucent white backgrounds (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)) with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) for iOS-style light glass cards.
Do keep text high-contrast (#0F172A for primary titles, #64748B for secondary labels).
donts: Don't use heavy dark void backgrounds or harsh black borders in light mode.
Don't use generic unstyled browser inputs or sharp 0px square corners.
